template_meta.name: Month End Close
template_meta.description: Manufacturing month-end close process: production cutoff, inventory counts, GR/IR reconciliation, WIP valuation, and financial review. 57 steps across all three perspectives.

entities.name: Material
entities.description: A physical item (raw material, component, or finished good)

derived_attributes.name: Reorder Strategy
derived_attributes.derivation: Metals use Min/Max due to price volatility, Non-Metals use Kanban

derived_attributes.name: Lead Time Class
derived_attributes.derivation: Metals may have longer lead times

derived_attributes.name: Valuation Method
derived_attributes.derivation: Metals use Moving Average (spot price-based), Non-Metals use Standard Cost

derived_attributes.name: Scrap Recovery Value Method
derived_attributes.derivation: Metals have positive recovery value, Non-Metals have disposal cost

entities.name: Time Entry
entities.description: Labor time recorded against an activity

entities.description: Vendor invoice for goods or services

entities.name: Goods Receipt
entities.description: Record of goods received from vendor

entities.name: Equipment
entities.description: A physical piece of production equipment or machinery

entities.name: Quality Inspection
entities.description: Quality inspection record for materials or production

attributes.name: System Stock Snapshot
attributes.description: System inventory quantities at a point in time

attributes.name: Goods Receipts (Inbound)
attributes.description: Records of goods received from vendors

attributes.name: Standard Costs
attributes.description: Standard cost master data for materials

constraints.description: Standard cost must be a non-negative value

attributes.name: Production Goods Movements
attributes.description: All goods movements related to production

attributes.name: Metal Spot Prices
attributes.description: Daily spot prices for metal materials (only for materials where Material_Type = 'Metal')
attributes.notes: Daily market prices for copper, aluminum, steel; only applies to metal materials

attributes.name: Metal Scrap Recovery
attributes.description: Metal scrap sold to recycling vendors with positive value
attributes.notes: Sales of metal scrap generate positive cash flow

attributes.name: Disposal Cost Postings
attributes.description: Disposal costs for non-metal scrap (negative value)

attributes.name: Equipment Downtime Events
attributes.description: Records of equipment downtime events and durations

attributes.name: Equipment Runtime
attributes.description: Machine operating hours tracked by sensors

measures.name: Material Cost Consumed
measures.description: Total material cost issued to production
measures.logic: Sum of material quantities issued multiplied by standard cost

measures.name: Labor Cost Applied
measures.description: Total labor cost applied to production
measures.logic: Sum of labor hours multiplied by labor rates

measures.name: Overhead Absorbed
measures.logic: Machine hours or labor hours multiplied by overhead rate

measures.name: Inventory Variance Quantity
measures.description: Difference between counted and system stock

measures.name: GR/IR Balance
measures.description: Value of goods received without matching invoice
measures.logic: GR value minus matched IR value

measures.name: Total Inventory Value
measures.description: Total value of inventory on hand
measures.logic: Sum of quantity multiplied by standard cost

measures.name: Metal Inventory Value
measures.description: Quantity × Current Spot Price (only for metals)
measures.logic: Sum of metal material quantities multiplied by current spot price

measures.name: Non-Metal Inventory Value
measures.logic: Sum of non-metal material quantities multiplied by standard cost

measures.name: Metal Scrap Recovery Value
measures.description: Metal scrap quantity × Scrap metal price (positive)
measures.logic: Revenue from selling metal scrap to recyclers

measures.name: Non-Metal Disposal Cost
measures.logic: Cost of disposing of non-metal waste

measures.name: Metal Price Variance
measures.logic: Difference between current market value and standard cost for metals

measures.name: Overall Equipment Effectiveness
measures.description: Availability × Performance × Quality - comprehensive equipment productivity metric
measures.logic: Product of availability rate, performance rate, and quality rate

measures.name: First-Pass Yield
measures.description: Percentage of production passing quality inspection on first attempt
measures.logic: Count of items passing first inspection divided by total items inspected
measures.formula: COUNT(inspection WHERE result = 'Pass' AND attempt = 1) / COUNT(inspection)

measures.name: Equipment Downtime Hours
measures.description: Total hours equipment was down for maintenance or failures

measures.name: Supplier Quality Score
measures.description: Weighted quality score based on defect rates and inspection results

measures.name: Inspection Pass Rate
measures.description: Percentage of inspections that pass without defects
measures.logic: Count of passing inspections divided by total inspections

processes.name: Month-End Close
processes.description: Close financial period and report accurate position

steps.name: Production Cutoff
steps.description: Confirm all completed production orders, no further confirmations for prior period

steps.name: Inventory Cutoff
steps.description: Complete all goods movements, freeze stock for counting

steps.name: Physical Count
steps.description: Count physical inventory

steps.name: Metal Inventory Revaluation
steps.description: Update metal inventory values to current spot prices, calculate price variances

steps.name: Count Reconciliation
steps.description: Compare counts to system, investigate variances, post adjustments

steps.name: GR/IR Reconciliation
steps.description: Match goods receipts to invoices, identify unmatched, post accruals

steps.name: Scrap Material Reconciliation
steps.description: Reconcile metal scrap sales and non-metal disposal costs, post to GL

steps.name: WIP Valuation
steps.description: Value work in progress orders, post variances

steps.name: Inventory Valuation
steps.description: Run inventory valuation, post to GL

steps.name: Production Order Settlement
steps.description: Settle completed production orders to receivers

steps.name: Close Review
steps.description: Review all metrics, approve period close

steps.name: Quality Variance Analysis
steps.description: Analyze quality performance, first-pass yield, and inspection results for the period

steps.name: Equipment Performance Review
steps.description: Review equipment OEE, downtime, and utilization metrics for the period

steps.name: Review Production Status
steps.description: Assess completion status of all active production orders and identify any open issues

steps.name: Execute Cutoff Procedure
steps.description: Lock production posting and freeze the period for month-end processing

steps.name: Query Open Orders in MES
steps.description: Run MES report for all orders with status 'In Progress' or 'Released'

steps.name: Verify Final Confirmations
steps.description: For each completed order: check final confirmation timestamp, verify all operations complete

steps.name: Process Pending Goods Movements
steps.description: Post all pending goods movements from production to warehouse in ERP

steps.name: Lock MES Period
steps.description: Execute period lock transaction in MES to prevent backdated confirmations

steps.name: Test and Document Lock
steps.description: Attempt test posting to verify period lock, document cutoff date and time

steps.name: Complete All Warehouse Transactions
steps.description: Process all pending receipts, issues, and transfers in WMS

steps.name: Freeze Stock for Count
steps.description: Lock inventory posting and generate count sheets

steps.name: Process Pending Receipts
steps.description: Post all goods receipts from production and suppliers in WMS

steps.name: Process Pending Issues
steps.description: Post all material withdrawals and consumption in WMS

steps.name: Generate Stock Snapshot
steps.description: Run WMS stock report to capture current on-hand quantities by location

steps.name: Lock WMS Period
steps.description: Execute period lock in WMS to prevent backdated inventory transactions

steps.name: Print Count Sheets
steps.description: Generate and print physical count sheets organized by warehouse zone

steps.name: Execute Physical Count
steps.description: Deploy count teams to perform wall-to-wall inventory count

steps.name: Review and Validate Counts
steps.description: Verify count quality, identify variances, perform recounts where needed

steps.name: Brief Count Teams
steps.description: Conduct briefing session with count teams on procedures and quality requirements

steps.name: Perform Zone Counts
steps.description: Count teams physically count all materials in assigned zones and record on count sheets

steps.name: Enter Counts into System
steps.description: Input physical count results from count sheets into WMS count module

steps.name: Run Variance Report
steps.description: Generate system vs. physical variance report highlighting discrepancies > 5%

steps.name: Execute Recounts
steps.description: Re-count all items with variances > 5% to verify accuracy

steps.name: Approve Final Counts
steps.description: Review recount results and approve final physical inventory values

steps.name: Calculate Inventory Values
steps.description: Run ERP valuation program to calculate inventory value at standard cost

steps.name: Post Valuation to GL
steps.description: Review valuation results and post inventory GL entries

steps.name: Run Standard Cost Valuation
steps.description: Execute ERP inventory valuation transaction using current standard costs

steps.name: Review Valuation Report
steps.description: Analyze inventory valuation report for unusual values or significant changes

steps.name: Generate GL Posting Document
steps.description: Create GL document from valuation results showing inventory and COGS accounts

steps.name: Post to General Ledger
steps.description: Execute GL posting transaction and verify balances updated correctly

steps.name: Identify Orders for Settlement
steps.description: Query all completed production orders ready for settlement

steps.name: Execute Settlement Run
steps.description: Run settlement program to allocate order costs to receivers

steps.name: Run Order Selection Report
steps.description: Generate list of completed orders with status TECO (technically complete)

steps.name: Verify Settlement Rules
steps.description: Check each order has correct settlement receiver and allocation rules configured

steps.name: Execute Settlement Transaction
steps.description: Run SAP CO88 settlement transaction to allocate WIP to finished goods

steps.name: Review Settlement Results
steps.description: Analyze settlement report for variances and verify all orders settled successfully

steps.name: Review Financial Metrics
steps.description: Analyze all key financial metrics and KPIs for reasonableness

steps.name: Review Operational Metrics
steps.description: Analyze operational performance metrics and identify issues

steps.name: Approve Period Close
steps.description: Final approval to close the financial period

steps.name: Review COGS vs Budget
steps.description: Compare actual COGS to budget and prior period, explain major variances

steps.name: Review Inventory Balance
steps.description: Validate inventory value vs prior month and investigate significant changes

steps.name: Review GR/IR Accrual
steps.description: Analyze GR/IR balance for aged items requiring investigation

steps.name: Review Production Yield
steps.description: Analyze yield rate trends and investigate poor performing orders

steps.name: Review Count Accuracy
steps.description: Analyze inventory accuracy metric and identify problem areas for improvement

steps.name: Prepare Executive Summary
steps.description: Create month-end summary report with key metrics and commentary

steps.name: CFO Sign-Off
steps.description: CFO reviews summary and formally approves period close
